page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top left. Faint show-through from the facing page on the right is not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Facultas itaq;, si omnibus imperat instru- mentis, pulsus facit,
Si infirma per se, non ita crebrò:
Si ualida, & humorum copia opprimatur, aut plane contumacia habeat instrumeta:
Si imbecilla magis, ut digitorû applicatio facultati oneri sit:

p.i: Inedia, vigilia, solicitudines, mœrores, uacuationes immodicæ per aluum, vel vrinas, vel vomitum, vel uterum, vel profluuium sanguinis, vehementes dolores, vel singulares, vt quem stomachicum vocant, & quæ cordis, vel arteriarum creant intemperiem, siue in succis, vel solidis continentur, siue foris antecedant.

page.notes: The running head and catchword are set in small capitals and italic; the bottom line "Instru-" is the catchword. Faint show-through text from the facing page is ignored. Some letters in the italic lines are uncertain, notably in "uacuationes" and "singulares".
